mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at a clear and quiet night with temperatures at 70 degrees, feeling like 72. It is a perfect night for stargazing along the Military Ridge State Trail under a Waxing Crescent moon, though there are no visible space station passes tonight.

In city news, Verona is sharing tips for apartment dwellers looking to compost, suggesting private collection services or dropping food waste off at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue. Additionally, the city is highlighting energy efficiency rebates for LED lighting, HVAC upgrades, and solar programs offered through Dane County.

We have an exciting lineup of events coming up. On July 19th, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Louie, or explore regional crafts at the Mount Horeb Art Fair. Later in the week, mark your calendars for trivia at Hop Haus on July 21st, and don't miss the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park on July 22nd.

In the police department's weekly recap, an incident occurred on Friday, July 10th, around 7:26 in the morning. Officers responded to a vehicle versus bicycle crash at Old PB and Whalen Road, where a cyclist sustained minor injuries and a local driver was cited for failing to yield the right of way.

Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Turtle, featuring rich hot fudge, hot caramel, and toasted pecans. While the Verona Culver's is currently closed, they will reopen at 10:00 AM tomorrow to serve up your favorite treats. Tomorrow's flavor is still a surprise, so stay tuned!
